subject: Ciências
description_pt: Explicar a organização básica das células e seu papel como unidade estrutural e funcional dos seres vivos.

components.description_pt: Identificar componentes estruturais básicos de uma célula (membrana celular, citoplasma, núcleo)
components.description_en: Identify the basic structural components of a cell (cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus)
components.cc_component_description: Identify specialized structures within a cell and describe their specific functions

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre células procarióticas e eucarióticas baseado em sua organização estrutural
components.description_en: Distinguish between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells based on their structural organization

components.description_pt: Explicar o papel da célula como unidade fundamental estrutural e funcional de organismos vivos
components.description_en: Explain the role of the cell as the fundamental structural and functional unit of living organisms
components.cc_component_description: Identify the cell as the smallest unit of life

components.description_pt: Usar modelo de célula para explicar como atividade coordenada de partes celulares mantém processos vitais
components.description_en: Use a cell model to explain how the coordinated activity of cell parts maintains life processes
components.cc_component_description: Use a cell model to explain how the coordinated activity of cell parts maintains life processes

cc_matches.description: Develop and use a model to describe the function of a cell as a whole and ways the parts of cells contribute to the function.
Within cells, special structures are responsible for particular functions, and the cell membrane forms the boundary that controls what enters and leaves the cell.

All living things are made up of cells, which is the smallest unit that can be said to be alive. An organism may consist of one single cell (unicellular) or many different numbers and types of cells (multicellular).
